configurePresets.name: windows-qt
configurePresets.description: Open this repo folder in Visual Studio ('File > Open > Folder') to use this preset. Requires the QT_DIR environment variable to point at your Qt kit (e.g. C:\Qt\6.7.0\msvc2022_64) - set it as a Windows environment variable and restart Visual Studio. OpenCV is picked up automatically from the bundled ocv440/ by CMakeLists.txt, no variable needed here.
